India Looks to Build on Recent Victory Against England

India is set to face England in the second One Day International (ODI) match, following their recent victory in the series opener. The English team aims to improve its performance with the bat, while India looks to build on its success. The match will be played at a neutral venue, and both teams are expected to field strong lineups.
